jobs.title: AI Engineer (Model & Pipeline Deployment)
jobs.why: Strong fit for Python, model deployment, pipelines, and MLOps in Riyadh.

jd.text:
Company Description

Jobs for Humanity is partnering with Alrkeen to build an inclusive and just employment ecosystem. Therefore, we prioritize individuals coming from all walks of life. Company Name: Alrkeen

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy AI models and data pipelines that address real-world business challenges. You will partner with stakeholders to translate measurable objectives into production‑grade ML solutions, balancing performance, reliability, security, and scalability.

Job Purpose

Own the end-to-end delivery of production AI/ML systems—modeling through deployment—improving accuracy and efficiency while ensuring reliable monitoring, security/compliance, and measurable impact.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

• Python

• PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Machine learning algorithms

• Deep learning architectures

• Data preprocessing and feature engineering

• Model evaluation (AUC, F1, RMSE)

• MLOps tools (Docker, CI/CD)

• Cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure)

• APIs for model serving

• SQL and big data tooling

• Deploy and monitor models in production reliably

• Optimize model performance and reduce latency

• Document solutions and ensure compliance

• Build scalable data pipelines for training and inference

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Python

• PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Machine learning algorithms

• Deep learning architectures

• Data preprocessing and feature engineering

• Model evaluation (AUC, F1, RMSE)

• MLOps tools (Docker, CI/CD)

• Cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure)

• APIs for model serving

• SQL and big data tooling

• Experience deploying ML models to production

• Knowledge of reliability and security best practices

• Ability to document and support compliance requirements

Company: Alrkeen

jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer: Retail AI
jobs.why: Judged on teaser; computer vision and C++ focus is adjacent to LLM engineering.

jd.text:
Position: Senior Computer Vision Engineer: Real-Time Retail AI

Rime is recruiting a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of state-of-the-art computer vision models that analyze real-time video streams from CCTV sources in Saudi Arabia. You will transform daily operations by delivering proactive AI insights and monitoring capabilities.

Ideal candidates have 2–4 years in computer vision with PyTorch and OpenCV, experience with YOLO and real-time optimization (TensorRT/ONNX), and strong Python and C++ skills.
